title: Slow Cooked Lamb Rogan Josh
summary: A rich Indian-style lamb rogan josh with tender shoulder, tomatoes and warm spices. It is dairy-free, deeply savoury and ideal for a comforting dinner served with rice or flatbread.

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder, cut into 3 cm chunks

steps: Pat the lamb dry and season it with half the salt and the black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a large heavy casserole over medium-high heat. Brown the lamb in batches for 6–8 minutes total, turning until well coloured on the outside, then transfer to a plate.
Reduce the heat to medium and add the remaining 1 tbsp oil. Add the onions and cook for 10–12 minutes, stirring often, until soft and golden at the edges.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Stir in the cumin, ground coriander, paprika, turmeric, cinnamon, cardamom and cayenne, and cook for 30 seconds to toast the spices.
Stir in the tomato paste, then add the canned tomatoes, vegetable stock, bay leaves and remaining salt. Scrape the base of the pan to lift any browned bits.

Return the lamb and any resting juices to the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer, then cover and cook on low heat for about 2 hours, stirring occasionally, until the lamb is very tender and pulls apart easily with a fork.
Remove the lid for the final 15–20 minutes if the sauce needs thickening; it should be glossy and cling to the lamb. Taste and adjust the salt if needed.
Discard the bay leaves, scatter over the fresh coriander and serve hot.
